findings.description: When the smartphone screen comes into focus, it displays nonsensical, malformed UI text (such as '74Z' next to a battery icon, 'A¯A', 'Ā7·42', and 'AZ - 12'). Between 00:04 and 00:09, these characters continuously warp and shift—a duplicate ghost '7' appears at 00:05, 'A¯A' migrates into the top status bar replacing '4.41' at 00:08, and the central 'Ā7·42' morphs into illegible dark scratch marks as the phone tilts at 00:09.

The person walking away at the bottom of the stairs is carrying a bright red bag in their left hand at 00:00–00:01, but between 00:01 and 00:02 the bag shrinks and vanishes entirely even though their left arm and side remain in view.
